title: Course Allotment Form (CAF) closes for all 1st years
summary: Every fresher must submit the CAF on the ERP portal to lock elective subjects for this semester. Portal has a history of crashing in the last 2 hours before deadline.
plainExplanation: CAF = Course Allotment Form. It's how you pick your elective subjects for the semester. If you don't submit it, the college picks defaults for you — usually not the ones you want.
seniorTip: Submit it the night before, not the deadline day — the portal buckles under load every single semester.

title: URGENT: Hostel water tanker delayed, supply from 6pm
summary: Forwarded in 4 hostel WhatsApp groups — unclear which warden actually confirmed this.
plainExplanation: This is a hostel-only logistics update about water supply timing. No form or action needed, just plan your day around it.
source: WhatsApp forward — Hostel Block C group

title: Anti-Ragging Affidavit mandatory for all freshers
summary: Upload the signed anti-ragging undertaking on the ERP before Sept 20 or your ID card will not be activated.
plainExplanation: A government-mandated form where you (and a parent) declare you understand anti-ragging rules. No ID card access without it — this blocks library, labs, and hostel mess too.
seniorTip: Get your parent's signature scanned in advance, it's the step everyone forgets and then panics about.

title: On Duty (OD) requests for the inter-college hackathon
summary: Students representing the college need OD approval from their class coordinator, applied at least 3 days before travel.
plainExplanation: OD = On Duty. It marks your attendance as 'present' even though you're away for an official college event, so it doesn't count as an absence.
seniorTip: Attach the event's official invite/poster to your OD form — coordinators approve those instantly.

title: Backlog exam registration window opens
summary: Students with pending backlogs from Sem 1/2 can register for the supplementary exam via the exam cell portal.
plainExplanation: A 'backlog' is a subject you failed or didn't clear. This is a second chance exam to clear it without waiting a full year.

title: Condonation form for students below 75% attendance
summary: If your attendance is between 65-75%, you must submit a condonation form with a medical/valid reason before the exam block.
plainExplanation: Condonation = official forgiveness for low attendance. Without it, you may not be allowed to sit for the semester exam at all.
seniorTip: Attach any proof you have, even a gym injury note — coordinators just need a paper trail, not a perfect excuse.

title: Free pizza at the CS Club recruitment drive tonight
summary: Someone forwarded this from a club Instagram story, no official confirmation from Student Affairs yet.
plainExplanation: Informal student-club event. Fun, optional, not an academic requirement.

title: Day scholar bus pass renewal — last date
summary: Bus pass for day scholars must be renewed at the transport office with fee payment receipt.
plainExplanation: Straightforward renewal — no jargon here. Just bring your fee receipt to the transport office in person.
seniorTip: Go before 10am, the queue triples by lunchtime.

title: CGPA recalculation for grade improvement students
summary: Students who re-attempted a subject for grade improvement should verify their recalculated CGPA on the ERP by Sept 24.
plainExplanation: CGPA = Cumulative Grade Point Average, your overall academic score across semesters. This notice only applies if you retook a subject specifically to improve your grade.

title: Mess menu change poll — vote by tonight
summary: Hostel council WhatsApp forward asking residents to vote for a new Friday dinner menu.
plainExplanation: Casual poll from the hostel council. Not an official administration notice, just student-run.

title: ECE freshers: lab coat & kit purchase deadline
summary: First-year ECE students must purchase the standard lab kit from the college store before the first practical session.
plainExplanation: No jargon — just buy your lab coat and toolkit from the store before your first lab class, or you won't be allowed in.
seniorTip: The store runs out of size M lab coats fastest — go early in the week.

title: Scholarship (NSP) document verification
summary: Students who applied for National Scholarship Portal (NSP) must complete offline document verification at the accounts office.
plainExplanation: NSP = National Scholarship Portal, a government scholarship scheme. This step is just proving your documents are real before the money is released.
seniorTip: Carry originals AND photocopies — they reject you at the counter if you only bring one set.

title: Placement pre-registration for penultimate year students
summary: 3rd years must pre-register on the placement portal to be eligible for pre-placement talks this season.
plainExplanation: This is only relevant if you're in your 3rd year. Pre-registering gets you invited to company talks before the actual placement drives begin.

title: Fresher's Night ticket sales open
summary: Official cultural committee event — tickets on sale at the amphitheater counter, limited seats.
plainExplanation: The welcome party for 1st years, organised by the cultural committee. Buy your ticket early since seats are limited.
seniorTip: Buy on day 1 of sales — the good seats near the stage go in under an hour.

title: Library fine waiver — one time amnesty window
summary: Library is waiving all overdue fines below ₹500 if books are returned this week only.
plainExplanation: No jargon here — return your overdue library books this week and any small fine gets cancelled.

title: Rumor: Semester exams postponed by 2 weeks
summary: Circulating heavily on batch WhatsApp groups, no confirmation on ERP, website, or from exam cell.
plainExplanation: This has NOT been confirmed anywhere official. Treat exam dates as unchanged until the exam cell posts a circular.
seniorTip: Every single batch gets this rumor right before exams. It has never once been true in 3 years.
